# 05 Motion

Full definition: [TAXONOMY.md](../../TAXONOMY.md), section 3.

**What belongs here.** The picture moves rigidly: A and B translate, rotate, scale or flip, whole or in rigid slices.

**Test.** Do the pixels keep their shape while they move?

**Not here.** Slices that bend, shatter or smear are 06 Distortion › Break. A zoom into an element containing B is 08 Carry › Portal.

**Build.** Remotion built-ins: slide(), flip(). Add motion blur (@remotion/motion-blur) to fast moves.

## Subfamilies

| Folder | What goes in it | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| [Push Slide](push-slide/) | B pushes A out, or slides over it. | push left, slide up, card stack |
| [Whip](whip/) | A very fast move with motion blur hiding the seam. | whip pan, whip zoom |
| [Zoom](zoom/) | Scale through the frame. | zoom-through, punch-in |
| [Spin](spin/) | Rotation in the picture plane. | spin, roll |
| [3D Space](3d-space/) | Rigid 3D moves of the frame. | flip, cube, fold, page turn |
| [Split](split/) | The frame divides into rigid slices that move apart or together. | split-screen slide, shutter halves |

## Transitions in this family

| Transition | Subfamily | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [Push](push-slide/push/) | Push Slide | The new scene pushes the old one out of frame. |
| [Slide Over](push-slide/slide-over/) | Push Slide | The new scene slides in over the old one like a card, with a soft shadow, while the old one drifts back and dims. |
| [Whip Pan](whip/whip-pan/) | Whip | A very fast pan with heavy motion blur that hides the cut, as if the camera whipped to the next scene. |
| [Grid Zoom](zoom/grid-zoom/) | Zoom | The camera pulls back until the old scene is one tile in a grid of tiles in the new colour, glides to the next tile and dives into it, which becomes the new scene. |
| [Zoom Through](zoom/zoom-through/) | Zoom | A circle in the new background colour opens on the old scene and the camera rushes into it; it fills the frame and the new scene lands. |
| [Spin](spin/spin/) | Spin | A shape in the new background colour spins in at the centre and grows while the camera rolls with it, until it fills the frame; the new scene then spins into place. |
| [Shutter](split/shutter/) | Split | The old scene splits into two halves that slide apart like doors, with the new scene behind them. |
| [Slice In](split/slice-in/) | Split | The new scene arrives in vertical slices that slide up into place one after another. |
| [Split Slices](split/split-slices/) | Split | The old scene breaks into horizontal slices that slide off alternately left and right, showing the new scene behind. |
